name: Kadrak's Flag
summary: At the edge of the Barrens and Ashenvale, Kadrak gives the Horde a mark to carry into enemy ground. The flag is planted in the Talon Den after Keymaster Rynthariel is killed.

sections.title: A Mark of Defiance
sections.body: Kadrak sends the Horde flag into the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak. The dryad Rynthariel, Keymaster of the Den, has sent communications across the border, and Kadrak decides her death alone will not answer them. He gives you the crimson banner to plant deep inside the Den. The Horde colors there carry a warning to the night elves and dryads: incursions across the Barrens will meet retaliation on Alliance soil.

faq.q: What is Kadrak's Flag used for?
faq.answer: Plant Kadrak's Flag inside the Talon Den atop Stonetalon Peak after killing Rynthariel the Keymaster. The Horde banner warns the night elves against sending more scouts and messengers into the Barrens.
Kadrak, an orc scout at the border watchpost between the northern Barrens and Ashenvale, gives you the banner as he works to secure the region.
Plant the banner inside the Talon Den, a cavern sanctuary on the western slopes of Stonetalon Peak in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Rynthariel is a dryad and Keymaster of the Talon Den. She sends messengers into Horde territory until Kadrak intercepts her communications and orders her killed.

angles.text: Planting the banner deep inside the Talon Den declares the Horde's strength and shows it will strike night elf sanctuaries when provoked.
For a night elf, the Horde banner inside the Talon Den is a direct insult to the protectors of Stonetalon Peak.
